result.title: A Local Agentic AI Framework to Generate Edge Case Scenarios for Safety Assurance
result.summary: Generating edge case scenarios is crucial for training, testing and safety assuring autonomous systems. This identifies hazardous failures to increase system reliability and robustness, ensures the system can still function safely on the boundaries of its operational design domain and learns the expected system behaviour for these edge cases. The rapid advancement in the generation and analysis capabilities of language models (LMs) has expanded their applicability and recent work has investigated LM scenario generation. However, many recent approaches rely on human-in-the-loop or rule-based strategies. This restricts the LM's ability to generate diverse and edge case scenarios; the long tail of the distribution. Our work uses local LMs in a laptop-based agentic AI framework for adaptive scenario generation. This is cheap, fully-controlled, ensures data privacy and security. It uses think, act, observe, update, and continue loops with lightweight JSON encoding to generate scenarios. We use the system requirements, system description and environment description as knowledge bases in contextual prompts for an LM to ensure scenario realism. A second, independent LM critiques each scenario using domain specific criteria so it can be refined. The refined scenarios are run in simulation and evaluation metrics collected. These metric scores are analysed and similar scenarios are created for edge cases (exploitation) or novel scenarios are generated to explore the scenario space. Post-hoc clustering using metric scores and thematic-type analysis of the rich-text scenario descriptions produced by the LM pinpoints functional gaps and their triggering conditions. This creates traceable evidence for the safety assurance case. Our work highlights the potential of a flexible and adaptive local agentic AI framework for automating edge case generation and producing traceable safety assurance evidence.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建了一个本地 LM 驱动的 agentic 框架，用 think-act-observe-update-continue 循环与 JSON 编码，配合独立 critic LM 和仿真指标，自动生成并迭代细化自动驾驶等系统的边缘场景，再用指标聚类定位功能缺口。
AI.relevance_reason: 其依据仿真指标在「利用已知场景」与「探索新场景」间自适应切换、并对外部化推理轨迹做批评-细化的循环，可能为 LVR 的动态计算分配与停止决策提供参照；但该工作全程使用文本状态、无 latent 表示与视觉证据使用，关联需人工核查。
